+    for qi, (xyz, roll) in zip(q, ORIGINS):
+        O = np.eye(4)
+        O[:3, :3] = rx(roll)
+        O[:3, 3] = xyz
+        T = T @ O
+        J = np.eye(4)
+        J[:3, :3] = rz(qi)
+        T = T @ J

+    def residual(q):

+        dp = (T[:3, 3] - goal[:3, 3])
+        dr = Rotation.from_matrix(goal[:3, :3] @ T[:3, :3].T).as_rotvec()
+        # A small posture term selects a nearby solution in the redundant joint.
+        return np.r_[dp, 0.16 * dr, 0.003 * (q - seed)]
